description: A struct-governing machine's guard references `self.nosuchfield`, absent from `Doc`. Per §51.3 the reference is rejected with E-ENGINE-013 (§34: Error), which names the valid fields.
rationale: §51.3 — a struct-governing machine's `given` guard addresses the governed value's fields through `self.`. A `self.<field>` reference naming a field the struct does not declare can never evaluate meaningfully, so it is a compile error rather than a runtime undefined read — the guard decides whether a transition is permitted, and a guard that silently reads absent is a transition contract that silently changes shape.
